summary: fix(auth): return incorrect password on reauth retry with signup salt
description:
Because:

* After a primary email change, a wrong password on /session/reauth returned
  errno 120 (incorrect email case) also on the client retry with the signup salt.

This commit:

* Returns errno 103 for a wrong password when originalLoginEmail is set.
* Sends originalLoginEmail on the signup-salt reauth in passwordChangeWithJWT.
* Adds unit tests and an integration test after a primary email change.
* Sends originalLoginEmail from the test client sessionReauth.

Closes FXA-14928
